blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Radar is a core sensor modality for scene perception to achieve higher levels of autonomy in automotive driving. A common occurrence in automotive radars is clutter - detections of non-existent moving objects, that can adversely impact target detection and classification performance and subsequent driving actions. We propose lightweight tiny graph transformer network (TGTNet) models for classifying clutter from stationary and moving targets in the scene. Performance evaluation on the public RadarScenes show that our proposed TGTNet models achieve similar classification performance in precision and recall metrics in comparison to state of the art models, with one to two orders of magnitude lower model size and significantly faster inference.
blocks.zh: 雷达是场景感知的一种核心传感器模式,可以实现更高的汽车驾驶自主性. 汽车雷达中常见的现象是杂乱无章的----对不存在的移动物体的探测,这可能对目标探测和分类性能以及随后的驾驶动作产生不利影响。 我们提出轻量级微小的图变压器网络(TGTNet)模型,用于从场景中的固定和移动目标进行杂乱分类. 对公共雷达场景的性能评价显示,我们提议的TGTNet模型在精确度和召回度量表方面与最新模型相比取得了相似的分类性能,模型大小低一至两个数量级,推论明显更快.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Automotive radars play an integral
role in advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous driving systems (ADS), by providing range, Doppler, and angular information of targets in the driving scene. Their low cost and environmentally robust sensing capabilities make radars a core sensor in various automotive driving functionalities, such as adaptive cruise control, lane assist, and autonomous emergency braking. However, despite their higher robustness in comparison to sensors like cameras and LiDARs, automotive radars are susceptible to signal artifacts, such as clutter.
blocks.zh:
汽车雷达是不可或缺的
在高级驾驶协助系统和自主驾驶系统中发挥作用,提供范围、多普勒和驾驶场目标角信息。 它们的低成本和环境强的感应能力使雷达成为各种汽车行驶功能的核心传感器,例如适应性巡航控制、航道协助和自动应急制动。 然而,尽管与相机和LiDARs等传感器相比其强度更高,但汽车雷达仍容易被信号文物所影响,如相通相通.

blocks.en: Radar clutter refers to erroneous detections in the radar system due to a non-existent object. As depicted in Fig. 1 for an illustrative scene, clutter can occur due to indirect signal propagation paths between the target and the radar, or erroneous ambiguity resolution in the radar processing chain. Specifically, ghost detections are a subclass of clutter detections that are caused by multipath signal reflections. These ghost targets often occur when radar signals bounce off large reflective surfaces such as buildings, metallic guardrails, other vehicles, or in environments like tunnels, and then arrive at the radar receiver via indirect paths [ 1 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 雷达拼接指由于一个不存在的物体而导致雷达系统中的错误探测. 如图1所描述的,由于目标与雷达之间的间接信号传播路径,或雷达处理链中错误的模糊分辨度,说明性场景可能发生杂乱. 具体来说,"幽灵探测"是一门由多路径信号反射而来,由多路径信号反射所引发的分类杂乱探测. 这些幽灵目标经常发生在雷达信号从建筑物,金属护栏等大型反射地表弹出,其他车辆,或在隧道等环境中弹出后,再通过间接路径到达雷达接收器[1,2].

blocks.en: Clutter detections impact the overall radar detection performance and can mislead decision-making processes, e.g., leading to faulty braking or steering maneuvers. Hence, robust detection and mitigation of clutter targets are essential for highly reliable radar sensing and perception.
blocks.zh: Clutter探测会影响整个雷达探测性能,并会误导决策过程,例如导致错误的制动或方向操纵. 因此,强力探测和减缓杂乱的目标对于高度可靠的雷达探测和感知至关重要。

Our main contributions are:

blocks.en: II Related literature
blocks.zh: 二. 相关文献

blocks.en:
One class of works for ghost target detection is based on signal processing approaches.
A simple model for ghost target detection based on the deviation of the angle of the motion vector from a box model was presented in [ 5 ] . The existence of multipath was modeled as a binary composite hypothesis test and a generalized likelihood ratio test detector was proposed in [ 6 ] to determine whether indirect paths exist in a range-Doppler cell. Both of these theoretical approaches were evaluated with limited simulations. In [ 1 ] , the authors observe that ghost detections are inherently a geometrical phenomenon, and propose a simple rule-based method for detecting clutter by employing searches within the detections at the current timestep and a buffer of the previous timesteps.
blocks.zh:
用于幽灵目标检测的一类作品是基于信号处理方法.
基于运动向量角度从一个盒子模型的偏差而提出的"幽灵目标探测"的简单模型在[5]中被提出. 多路径的存在被建模为二进制复合假说测试,在[6]中提出了通用概率比测试检测器,以确定在范围-多普勒细胞中是否存在间接路径. 这两种理论方法都经过有限的模拟评估。 在[1]中,作者认为"鬼魂探测"本质上是一种几何现象,并提出了一种简单的基于规则的探测方法,通过在目前时间步内使用探测器内部的搜索和前几起时间步的缓冲来探测杂乱.

blocks.en:
A multistage rule-based multipath ghost object labeling technique leveraging LiDAR is proposed in [ 7 ] .
Region proposals of multipath ghost reflections are created by reflecting real objects off reflective surfaces, and then candidate ghost reflections are chosen based on a Mahalanobis distance threshold. Performance is reported on the Radar Ghost dataset [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
[7]中提出了多阶段基于规则的多路径鬼物体标签技术来利用LiDAR.
多路径幽灵反射的区域提案是通过从反射表面反射出真实物体来创建的,然后根据马哈拉诺比斯的距离阈值选择候选幽灵反射. 雷达幽灵数据集报告性能[2].

blocks.en: As data-driven point cloud processing methods gained traction, deep learning methods for clutter handling have emerged. The Ghost Radar Dataset in [ 2 ] is currently the only publicly available dataset that provides manually labeled ghost objects. The annotations are, however, limited to a single type of multipath reflection that is caused by a single reflective surface. Along with the dataset, two instance segmentation methods were presented that use PointNet ++ [ 8 ] as the semantic segmentation backbone. The first method utilizes a similarity group proposal network [ 9 ] in an end-to-end training scenario, while the second method applies the well-known DBSCAN algorithm [ 10 ] to the semantic segmentation outputs.
blocks.zh: 随着由数据驱动的点云处理方法获得牵引力,出现了关于杂乱处理的深层学习方法. [2]中的"幽灵雷达数据集"是目前唯一公开提供人工标记的"幽灵"对象的数据集. 然而,说明仅限于由单一反射地表所引发的单一类型的多路径反射. 与数据集一起,提出了使用PointNet ++ [8]作为语义分解主干线的两个实例分解方法. 第一种方法在一端到一端的训练情景中利用了相似性组建议网络[9],而第二种方法将众所周知的DBSCAN算法[10]应用于语义分解输出.

blocks.en: In [ 11 ] , a modified PointNet ++ [ 8 ] variant with two abstraction levels was proposed for moving object segmentation. Training and testing were done on the RadarScenes dataset [ 3 ] by aggregating points in a 500 ms time window. The architecture was designed to process point clouds with a fixed size of 3072 points. If the point cloud has fewer points, it is oversampled; if it has more points, it is undersampled by selecting the points with the highest Doppler values.
blocks.zh: 在[11]中,提出了具有两个抽象级的经过修改的PointNet++ [8]变体,用于移动对象分解. 在雷达场景数据集[3]上进行了培训和测试,将点数汇总在一个500分/秒的时间窗口中。 建筑设计处理点云,固定大小为3072分. 如果点云的分数较少,则被过度抽取;如果有较多分数,则通过选择多普勒值最高的分数来进行下抽取.

blocks.en: An automatically labeled public dataset with clutter detections was proposed in [ 4 ] , along with a modified deep learning architecture for ghost object detection. The automatic labeling method was applied to the RadarScenes dataset, which provided annotations for moving objects. First, the background detections found in close proximity to the “real” moving object were also labeled as “real” to account for radar imprecision. All the remaining detections that have the ego-motion-compensated radial speed above a certain threshold were marked as “clutter”. The authors then proposed a modified version of the PointNet ++ architecture from [ 11 ] and tested it on both the new dataset and the private dataset from their previous work [ 1 ] to validate the label generation method. The model input was reduced to a smaller fixed size of 1280 points. Point clouds were aggregated in a queue of fixed size, with the oldest points discarded when new points come in. The point clouds were then brought to the same coordinate space using ego motion information, and training was done by oversampling points such that every sample in the batch had the same number of points. This method and the one in [ 11 ] are both specifically tailored to radar point clouds, making them suitable baselines for our models.
blocks.zh: 在[4]中提出了自动标注有拼接检测功能的公共数据集,同时提出了用于幽灵对象检测的修改后深度学习架构. 自动标签方法被应用于雷达场景数据集,该数据集为移动对象提供了说明. 首先,在靠近“真正的”移动物体时发现的背景探测也标为“真正的”以说明雷达不精确。 所有剩余探测器的自负-运动补偿射线速度均高于某一阈值,均被标记为“复杂”。 作者随后从[11]提出"PointNet ++"架构的修改版本,并同时从他们之前的作品[1]中测试出新数据集和私人数据集,以验证标签生成方法. 模型输入被缩小为1280分更小的固定尺寸. 点云被集合成固定大小的队列,最古老的点被新点入来时丢弃. 然后用自负运动信息将点云带入同一个坐标空间,训练是通过过度取样点完成的,因此批中每个样本都有相同的分数. 这种方法和[11]中的方法都专门适合雷达点云,使它们适合我们的模型。

blocks.en: The Point Transformer was proposed in [ 12 ] . The Gaussian Radar Transformer (GRT), a new point transformer segmentation model, was presented in [ 13 ] , employing a decoupled point attention mechanism that facilitates the flow of gradients. To enhance the model’s ability to learn spatial relations, attentive downsampling and upsampling layers were proposed, utilizing a simplified translation-sensitive attention mechanism that eliminates the need for key, query, and value separation. The model was trained and tested without any temporal aggregation by merging frames from all sensors into a single point cloud. Using this architecture, state-of-the-art performance was achieved on the RadarScenes moving object segmentation task.
blocks.zh: 点变相器是在 [12] 中提出的. 高斯雷达变压器(GRT)是一种新的点变压器分流模型,在[13]中被提出,它采用了一种能为梯度流提供方便的去相接点的注意机制. 为了增强模型学习空间关系的能力,建议采用简化的对翻译敏感的注意机制,消除对钥匙、查询和价值分离的需要,进行细心的下取样和上取样。 该模型经过培训和测试,没有经过任何时间聚合,将所有传感器的帧合并成单一点云. 利用这一架构,在雷达场景移动物体分块任务上实现了最先进的性能.

blocks.en: Generally, deep learning approaches to clutter detection in literature use variations of PointNet ++ with various methods for point cloud aggregation, without consideration to model complexity which is an important aspect for automotive edge implementations. In this work, we extend our previous work [ 14 ] and develop models that take advantage of recent advances in graph neural networks and transformer architectures that have thus far been overlooked. We efficiently extend our models proposed in [ 14 ] to time domain capabilities, and present additional qualitative visualizations as well as new quantitative results on a second dataset, the Radar Ghost Dataset [ 2 ] , showcasing the wider applicability of our models.
blocks.zh: 一般来说,在文献中,用PointNet ++的变体进行拼凑检测的深层学习方法,采用各种点云聚合方法,而不考虑模型的复杂性,这是汽车边缘实施的一个重要方面。 在这项工作中,我们扩展了我们先前的工作[14],并开发出利用了图神经网络和变压器结构方面最新进展的模型,这些模型迄今为止一直被忽略. 我们有效地将[14]提出的模型扩展至时间域能力,并在第二套数据集雷达幽灵数据集[2]上提出额外的定性可视化以及新的定量结果,显示了我们模型更广泛的适用性。

blocks.en: To facilitate learning local features, we additionally introduce a new module, the Superpoint Block, which extracts features from a clustered point cloud input. The base building block of the Superpoint Blocks is the Superpoint Transformer. The Superpoint transformer takes as input a clustered point cloud and extracts the mean and standard deviation of the positions and features, resulting in N S N_{S} superpoint positions [ p ¯ s , p s ( std ) ] [\bar{p}_{s},p_{s}^{(\mathrm{std})}] and N S N_{S} superpoint features [ x ¯ s , x s ( std ) ] [\bar{x}_{s},x_{s}^{(\mathrm{std})}] , where s s represents a unique cluster index. The superpoint positions and features extracted from the clusters are then treated as a point cloud and passed through a GTB. Finally, the output superpoints are applied a gather operation, which assigns to each original point the relevant output superpoint that represents the same cluster to which the point belongs. Used in conjunction with a skip connection, the Superpoint Transformer extracts useful features for each point based on the cluster mean and spread as well as the relations to nearby clusters of similar spread. Based on the Superpoint Transformer, two Superpoint Block versions are then proposed, as seen in Fig. 2 .

To cluster the point clouds, we branch out from the pervasive DBSCAN algorithm [ 10 ] and its variants, which are often used in radar point cloud clustering. In that sense, we partition the point cloud using a global energy model similar to the one used in [ 17 ] . Therefore, the energy model is defined on top of the kNN of the point cloud and considers the Cartesian positions as a signal f ∈ ℝ N × c f\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times c} . The objective is to find a piecewise constant signal g g that approximates f f by minimizing the energy model g ⋆ = arg ​ min g ∈ ℝ N × c ∑ i = 1 N | | g i − f i | | 2 + λ ∑ i = 1 N ∑ j ∈ kNN ⁡ ( i ) [ g i ≠ g j ] , g^{\star}=\argmin_{g\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times c}}\sum_{i=1}^{N}||g_{i}-f_{i}||^{2}+\lambda\sum_{i=1}^{N}\sum_{j\in\operatorname{kNN}(i)}[g_{i}\neq g_{j}]\mathrm{,} (5) where the [ ⋅ ] [\cdot] operator is known as the Iverson bracket. This energy model consists of two parts: one that ensures fidelity to the original signal through the squared Euclidean norm, and a regularizer with regularization strength λ \lambda that determines the number of distinct values in the signal. The partition is then defined as the connected components of the kNN graph for which the approximated signal g ⋆ g^{\star} is constant.
Despite the direct minimization of the energy model not being computationally tractable, it can be efficiently approximated by the iterative ℓ 0 \ell_{0} -cut pursuit algorithm in [ 18 ] .

blocks.en: Our approach diverges from DBSCAN due to its sensitivity to hyperparameter selection and its limitations when handling clusters with varying densities. Additionally, DBSCAN often classifies isolated detections as noise, resulting in the loss of potentially valuable information. In contrast, the proposed energy-based clustering method is specifically designed to accommodate the sparsity and irregularity of radar point clouds. This, in turn, ensures that our Superpoint Block learns important local relations between elements with simple shapes. To augment TGTNet with the Superpoint Blocks, the blocks are prepended to TGTNet. The models augmented with the normal and light versions of the Superpoint Block are then called S-TGTNet and SL-TGTNet, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法与DBSCAN不同,因为它对超参数选择很敏感,在处理密度不同的集群时也有局限性。 此外,DBSCAN经常将孤立的检测归类为噪声,导致潜在有价值信息的丢失. 相形之下,所拟议的以能为主的集合法是专门设计的,以适应雷达点云的溅射和不规则. 这反过来又确保了我们的"超级点"(Superpoint Block)学习了简单形状的元素之间的重要地方关系. 为了用"超级点块"来增强TGTNet,这些块被准备到TGTNet. 与"Superpoint Block"的平面和光面版本相扩充的模型后被分别称为"S-TGTNet"和"SL-TGTNet".

blocks.en: Our architecture, the Tiny Graph Transformer Network (TGTNet), takes the form of a simplified U-Net [ 19 ] with only one level of abstraction. The architecture is designed with translation invariance in mind and can operate on point clouds of varying sizes. Therefore, the input point cloud is passed through a pointwise linear layer, then through a downsampling layer. The downsampled point cloud is passed through a Gaussian Transformer Block (GTB) and another pointwise linear layer before being upsampled again through the upsampling block with a skip connection from the first linear layer. The upsampled point cloud is finally passed through a pointwise classification head MLP with two layers.

blocks.en: To downsample the point cloud, we employ the farthest-point sampling (FPS) algorithm, first proposed for use on point clouds in PointNet++ [ 8 ] , and set the downsampling ratio to halve the number of points after downsampling. To facilitate learning useful features for the downsampled point clouds, we again take inspiration from [ 13 ] and their attentive downsampling layer. The attentive downsampling layer presented in [ 13 ] uses a simplified attention mechanism that operates on the downsampled point cloud by aggregating the features of the 9-nearest neighbors in the original point cloud. Instead of using three separate matrices for extracting query, key, and value representations, the authors draw inspiration from [ 20 ] and process the features using a shared pointwise MLP. They then calculate the weights by applying a second MLP to the processed weights, concatenated with the Cartesian positions.
blocks.zh: 为下取样点云,我们采用了最远点采样(FPS)算法,首先在PointNet++ [8]中提出用在点云上,并设定下取样比,将下取样后点数减半. 为了帮助学习下取样点云的有用特征,我们再次从 [13] 及其细心下取样层汲取灵感。 [13]中呈现的细心下采样层采用简化的注意机制,通过将原点云中最相邻的9个相邻相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相 作者不使用三个独立的矩阵来提取查询,密钥和值表示,而是从 [20] 中汲取灵感,并使用共享的指针MLP处理特征. 然后,他们通过对已加工的重量应用第二个MLP来计算权重,与笛卡尔位置相配合.

blocks.en: Due to the lack of positional invariance of the aforementioned attentive downsampling layer combined with the high parameter count from the use of two input MLPs, we propose our own attentive downsampling layer. To this end, our layer reverts back to the full attention in ( 4 ) and applies it on the downsampled point cloud by aggregating points from the original point cloud. In order to introduce more knowledge about the local regions of the downsampled points, the attention layer output for each point is concatenated with the standard deviation of the Cartesian coordinates in the aggregated region before being multiplied by the output projection ω \omega .
blocks.zh: 由于缺乏上述细心下采样层的位置偏差,加上使用两个输入式MLP的高参数计数,我们提议我们自己细心下采样层。 为此,我们的地层在(4)中恢复到完全的注意,并通过从原来的地点云中汇总出点来将其应用到被下标点云上. 为了引入更多关于被下取样点的局部区域的知识,每个点的注意力层输出会与集成地的笛卡尔坐标的标准偏差相接而成,然后被输出投射出QQ\omega.

blocks.en: The upsampling layer uses the same idea as the downsampling layer. This time, the query features originate from the skip connection of the first pointwise linear layer, while the key and value features originate from the downsampled point cloud. The only other difference is that the resulting queries, keys, and values must share the same dimension; however, the points they originate from have different feature dimensions, so a common dimension needs to be chosen for the features to be projected to. As a result, we decided to project everything to the dimensions of the skip connections.
blocks.zh: 上采样层与下采样层使用相同的想法. 这一次,查询功能来源于第一个点向线性层的跳过连接,而密钥和值功能来源于被下取样的点云. 唯一的其他区别是由此产生的查询,密钥和值必须具有相同的维度;然而,它们源于不同的特征维度,因此需要选择一个共同的维度来预测特征. 因此,我们决定把一切都投射到跳过连接的维度上.

blocks.en: To further decrease the memory footprint of our model, we also test modified versions of the attention layer and Gaussian Transformer Block architectures that learn low-rank (LoRa) adaptations for a subset of the linear layers. Inspired by LoRa adaptations [ 21 ] and the recent advancements in LLMs brought by DeepSeek-v3 [ 22 ] , we propose the use of learning compressed representations in our attention layers and label the models that use this attention as “LoRa” models.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步减少我们模型的内存足迹,我们还测试了注意力层和高斯变形板块架构的修改后版本,这些架构为线性地层的一个子集学习了低等(Lora)的适应. 受LoRa改编[21]和DeepSeek-v3[22]介绍的LLMs最新进步的启发,我们提议在我们的关注层使用学习压缩表达,并将使用这种关注的模型标注为"LoRa"模型.

blocks.en: To this end, the LoRa variants of the base models have all attentive layers modified, while augmentation blocks used for models have their own separate LoRa qualifier. For the Gaussian Transformer Block and our proposed attentive downsampling and upsampling layers, the linear projection matrices in ( 4 ) that extract the query, key, and value are transformed into low-rank projections. As a result, a matrix W ∈ ℝ d 1 × d 2 W\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{1}\times d_{2}} is transformed into two subsequent projection matrices A ∈ ℝ k × d 2 A\in\mathbb{R}^{k\times d_{2}} and B ∈ ℝ d 1 × k B\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{1}\times k} , with k k being the compressed dimension. Furthermore, the keys and values are extracted using the same shared compression matrix, but different decompression matrices. In the case of the Gaussian Transformer Block, the linear layers that encapsulate the attention layer are also transformed into low-rank projections.
blocks.zh: 为此,基站模型的LoRa变体进行了所有细心层的修改,而用于模型的增强块则有自己的单独的LoRa修饰. 对于高斯变形板块和我们提议的 细心下采样和上采样层, 提取查询的(4)线性投影矩阵, 键和值被转化为低等的预测。 因此,矩阵 W QQ R d 1 × D 2 W\in\ mathbb{ R}^{d_{1}\times d_{2}}被转换为后两个预测矩阵 A QQR k × d 2 A\in\ mathbb{ R}^{k\ tims d_{2}}和 B∈1 R 1×K B\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{1}\times k},以 kk为压缩维. 此外,使用相同的共享压缩矩阵来提取密钥和值,但解压缩矩阵不同. 在高斯变形板块中,封装了注意力层的线性地层也转化为低等的预测.

blocks.en: In all cases, we empirically chose the compressed dimension to be the input dimension divided by 8. For layers that process input features of different dimension sizes, we chose the larger input dimension of the two.

blocks.en: Our models were trained and evaluated on the RadarScenes dataset [ 3 ] ; the method in [ 4 ] was used to for ground truth class labels. We utilize the original dataset split from [ 3 ] in conjunction with the additional test and validation split from [ 13 ] . Specifically, sequences 6, 42, 58, 85, 99, and 122 are assigned to the validation set, while the remaining sequences from the original validation set are used for the test set. The RadarScenes dataset comprises radar scans from four frequency modulated continuous waveform (FMCW) radar sensors positioned on either side of the car’s front bumper, covering different angles. To guarantee that a single radar snapshot captures the entire field of view of the car, the scans were merged from all four sensors in a single frame. The point features we trained our models on are the Cartesian positions in car coordinates, x c ​ c , y c ​ c x_{cc},y_{cc} , the ego-motion compensated radial velocity, v ^ r , s ​ c \hat{v}_{r,sc} , and the radar cross-section (RCS), σ \sigma . Therefore, a point comprises of position p = [ x c ​ c , y c ​ c ] p=[x_{cc},y_{cc}] and features x = [ x c ​ c , y c ​ c , v ^ r , s ​ c , σ ] x=[x_{cc},y_{cc},\hat{v}_{r,sc},\sigma] . Some models are also tested using the extended feature set used in [ 4 ] , which additionally contains the distance r s ​ c r_{sc} and azimuth ϕ s ​ c \phi_{sc} in sensor coordinates, the timestamp t t in seconds relative to the latest frame, and the sensor id s i ​ d s_{id} , resulting in x = [ x c ​ c , y c ​ c , v ^ r , s ​ c , σ , r s ​ c , ϕ s ​ c , t , s i ​ d ] x=[x_{cc},y_{cc},\hat{v}_{r,sc},\sigma,r_{sc},\phi_{sc},t,s_{id}] . The choice of including the Cartesian positions into the features makes the models lose their translation invariance property, but improves performance.

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Model and training details
blocks.zh: 模式和培训细节

blocks.en: For training, we chose to train all models for 50 epochs on RadarScenes and 30 epochs on the Radar Ghost Dataset, and then select the model with the highest F1 score for clutter. For our tests, we employ a combination of the Lovász-Softmax loss [ 24 ] and a weighted cross-entropy loss. The Lovász-Softmax loss is calculated by applying the Lovász continuous extension to the Jaccard index, and using the resulting extension on the probability distribution output of the model. Therefore, for predicted labels y ^ \hat{y} and ground truth labels y y , our loss is defined as ℒ ⁡ ( y ^ , y ) = ℒ L ​ o ​ v ​ a ´ ​ s ​ z ​ ( y ^ , y ) + ℒ C ​ E ​ ( y ^ , y , w c ) , \mathcal{L}(\hat{y},y)=\mathcal{L}_{Lov\acute{a}sz}(\hat{y},y)+\mathcal{L}_{CE}(\hat{y},y,w_{c})\mathrm{,} (12) where w c w_{c} is the vector of the class weights. For RadarScenes, this vector is set empirically to 0.5, 8, and 8 for the stationary, moving object, and clutter classes, respectively. For the Radar Ghost Dataset, we employ the method described in [ 25 ] and calculate the weights based on the effective number of samples. Due to the Lovász-Softmax loss being a tractable surrogate for the mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) metric, we apply it only to clutter and moving object detections to prevent large gradients caused by background class errors in the early stages of training. Moreover, the loss is applied to each individual point cloud from the minibatch and then averaged, thereby ensuring the sample mIoU is maximized. For optimization, we use the Adam optimizer [ 26 ] with a learning rate of 0.0005 and a batch size of 32. The learning rate is reduced after each epoch according to a cosine annealing scheduler [ 27 ] with no restarts.
blocks.zh: 在训练方面,我们选择了在雷达场景上为50个纪元培训所有模型,在雷达幽灵数据集上为30个纪元培训所有模型,然后选择F1得分最高的纪元来进行拼接. 对于我们的测试,我们采用Lovász-Softmax损失[24]和加权交叉性损失的组合. Lovász-Softmax损失的计算方法是将Lovász连续扩展应用到Jaccard指数,并使用由此而来扩展的模型概率分布输出. 因此,对于预测的标签y ^\hat{y}和地面的真理标签y y,我们的损失被定义为 L → (y ^, y ) = L L o v a' s z (y ^, y ) + L C E (y ^, y, w C),\ mathcal{L}(\hat{y}, y)\ mathcal{L}_{Lov\a}\ sz}(\hat{y},y)\ mathcal{L}_{CE}(\hat{y},y,w_{c})\ mathhrm{,}(12) 其中w c w_{c}是类重的向量 。 对于雷达场景,这种向量按经验分别被设定为固定物体、移动物体和杂乱类的0.5、8和8。 对于"雷达幽灵数据集",我们采用[25]所描述的方法,并根据有效样本数量来计算权重. 由于Lovász-Softmax损失是平均相交-交叉-结合(mIoU)度量的可牵引代用物,所以我们只将其应用于杂交和移动对象检测,以防止在培训初期因背景班级错误而导致的大梯度. 此外,损失适用于从小批量抽取出的每一个点云,然后进行平均值计算,从而确保将样本mIoU最大化。 为了优化,我们使用亚当优化器[26],学习率为0.0005,分批大小为32. 学习速率在每一纪元后按照一个相弦反射排程器来降低[27],没有重启.

blocks.en: For our model, we tested two dimensions of size 16 and 32. The overall dimension is kept by the downsampling layer and the Gaussian Transformer Block, while the pointwise layer that follows the transformer block doubles it, and the upsampling layer reduces it back down to its original size. For the temporal models, we standardize the positions to the [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] range and normalize the other features by subtracting their training set mean and dividing by the standard deviation. The Cartesian positions are normalized together so as not to skew the neighborhood computations. The kNN neighborhoods that the layers operate on are set to k = 9 k=9 for the upsampling and downsampling layers and k = 16 k=16 for the Gaussian transformer block layers, which are the same parameters used in [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于我们的模型,我们测试了大小16和32的两个维度. 整体维度由下采样地层和高斯变形板块所保持,而沿变形板块所走的指向层将它翻倍,而上采样层则将它降低到原来的尺寸. 对于时间模型,我们将位置标准化到[− 1, 1] [-1, 1] 范围,并将其他特征正常化,减去其训练集平均值并除以标准偏差。 笛卡尔的位置被固定在一起,以免扭曲附近的计算。 地层运行的克NN街区被设定为克=9克=9,用于上下取样地层;而高斯变压器块层被设定为克=16克=16,这与[13]中使用的参数相同.

blocks.en: For the superpoint blocks, we chose the block dimension to be the same as the dimension of the base model it augments, thus 16 or 32. The clustering hyperparameters are selected to facilitate the extraction of geometric primitives while ensuring the number of superpoints is kept to a minimum. Therefore, we settled on the kNN number of neighbors to be k = 10 k=10 and the regularization strength λ = 1 \lambda=1 . The Superpoint block output dropout probability is set to 0.1.

blocks.en: For the temporal augmentations, we chose to use six frames for all methods. The GRU uses a dimension of 16 for the embeddings along with a radius of 5 for the neighborhood function, limited to at most 32 neighbors.

blocks.en:
To evaluate model performance, we report precision, recall and F1 metrics for the entire test set for all of the classes. The reported mean F1 scores are macro-averaged, treating all classes with equal importance regardless of dataset imbalance. We also compare the inference time of the models, as well as their size (a small memory footprint is desired for real-time inference in ADAS [ 28 ] ), which is reported for 32-bit floating point parameters.
When measuring inference time, all models are tested under the same conditions and with the same input point cloud, taking into account the frame aggregation method employed by each model. Using a single RTX A6000 GPU, a total of 100 runs are averaged to compute the inference time.

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Quantitative results
blocks.zh: 四-B 1 量化结果

blocks.en: The base TGTNet architecture is first evaluated against the GRT for different combinations of hyperparameters on the reduced feature set to analyze how the proposed size reduction techniques affect performance, with results reported in Table I . It can be observed that using LoRa layers instead of regular layers has a negligible effect on performance while simultaneously halving the memory footprint. However, despite LoRa layers requiring fewer operations for the matrix multiplications, there is, on average, a less than 1ms (5%) increase in inference time due to the matrix multiplications executing sequentially. A greater performance difference is observed when changing the model size directly. It can be seen that the performance degrades by only 1–2% across metrics when using the smaller model (dim 16 vs. dim 32), while the memory footprint is four times smaller. Such a performance drop can be justifiable when resources are scarce. Compared to the GRT, the best-performing TGTNet models only have a 2% loss in moving object F1 performance and a 1% loss in clutter F1 performance, while being 200 times smaller and having almost a 4 times faster inference time.
blocks.zh: 基础的TGTNet架构首先根据GRT在已缩小的特性集上对超参数的不同组合进行评价,以分析拟议缩小尺寸技术如何影响性能,结果在表一中报告. 可以看到,使用LoRa地层而不是正平地层对性能影响可忽略不计,同时将记忆足迹减半. 然而,尽管LoRa层对矩阵乘法的操作需要较少,但由于矩阵乘法按顺序执行,平均推论时间增加不到1ms(5%)。 在直接改变模型大小时观察到更大的性能差异. 可以看出,在使用更小的模型(dim 16 vs. dim 32)时,性能在各种度量上只降解了1–2%,而内存足迹则小了4倍. 在资源匮乏的情况下,这种业绩下降是有道理的。 相较于GRT,性能最好的TGTNet模型在移动对象F1性能上只有2%的亏损,而Clutter F1性能上只有1%的亏损,同时体积更小200倍,推论时间也几乎快了4倍.

blocks.en: Table II shows tests for Superpoint block augmentations using LoRa models as the base. It can be noticed that the regular Superpoint Block generally performs better than the light Superpoint Block. SL-TGTNet achieves only a 1% improvement for moving object F1 compared to TGTNet, while S-TGTNet achieves a 4% moving object F1 increase and a 1% clutter F1 increase. This occurs because the normal Superpoint Block provides an additional full GTB that adds expressivity to the model. By testing LoRa variants of the Superpoint Blocks independently from the base model, we observe that LoRa offers no performance degradation. Regarding the model size, an increase of 1% F1 for moving objects and an almost 2% increase in F1 for clutter objects can be noticed, increases which are similar to those observed in the base models.
blocks.zh: 表二显示使用LORA模型作为底座的超点块增强的测试. 可以注意到的是,普通的"超级点块"(Superpoint Block)一般表现优于"光"(Superpoint Block). SL-TGTNet与TGTNet相比,移动对象F1仅实现1%的改进;而S-TGTNet则实现4%的移动对象F1增加和1%的clutter F1增加. 之所以发生这种情况,是因为普通的"超级点块"(Superpoint Block)提供了额外的全GTB,增加了模型的表达性. 通过独立于基准模型的超点区块的LORA变体测试,我们观察到LORA不提供性能降解. 关于模型大小,可以注意到移动对象增加1%的F1和杂交对象增加近2%的F1,这些增加与基准模型中观察到的增加相似。

blocks.en: Additional tests are done by augmenting the base model with different methods that embed temporal information into the model, as can be seen in Table III . The first method, GRU-TGTNet, involves adding a graph GRU module as a temporal feature extraction block before the model. The second method, TGTNet-T, retains the same parameter set as the base model and utilizes the downsampling layer as a shared layer across different frames before aggregating them together. It can be noticed that, despite its simplicity, TGTNet-T achieves 1% higher clutter and moving object F1 scores compared to the more complex and slower GRU feature extraction method.
blocks.zh: 如表三所示,通过采用不同方法将时间信息嵌入模型中,对基准模型进行再加测试。 第一种方法GRU-TGTNet涉及在模型之前添加一个图GRU模块作为时间特征提取块. 第二种方法是TGTNet-T,保留了与基准模型相同的参数设置,并将下采样层作为跨越不同框架的共享层,然后将它们聚合在一起. 可以注意到,尽管TGTNet-T简单,但与更复杂更慢的GRU特征提取方法相比,TGTNet-T实现了1%的相克和相克移动对象F1分数.

blocks.en: Further performance can be achieved by combining Superpoint Block feature extraction with parallel downsampling, as can be observed from the results of the TGTNet-T models. Every frame is processed separately by the same shared Superpoint Block and then passed onto the parallel downsampling network. This method offers an advantage of more than 1% F1 for the clutter class and achieves the same or higher F1 for moving objects, compared to the best metrics obtained by the baselines, while having a 20 times smaller memory footprint, and maintaining similar inference time. Moreover, it can be observed that the regular Superpoint Block brings a 1% increase in F1 for moving objects in the temporal model, while the clutter detection performance is similar.
blocks.zh: 通过将Superpoint Block特征提取与平行下采样相结合,可以进一步实现性能,这可以从TGTNet-T模型的结果中观察到. 每个帧都由同一个共享的Superpoint Block单独处理,然后传递到平行的下采样网络上. 这种方法为杂交类提供了超过1%的F1的优势,与基线获得的最佳度量相比,在移动对象上实现了相同或更高的F1,同时具有20倍小的内存足迹,并保持了相近的推论时间. 此外,可以观察到正则的Superpoint Block在时间模型中为移动对象带来了1%的F1增量,而杂乱的检测性能相近.

blocks.en: Tables II and III also feature comparisons of DBSCAN with energy model clustering, demonstrating that the latter yields superior mean F1 scores across temporal and non-temporal model variants without increasing computational cost.
blocks.zh: 表二和表三还列出了DBSCAN与能量模型集群的比较情况,表明后者在不增加计算成本的情况下,在时间和非时间模型变量之间得出了优异的F1平均分数。

blocks.en: Table IV shows results for our model against a modified version of PointNet ++ . This version keeps the exact same architecture as the “semantic scene labelling” architecture described in the original PointNet ++ paper [ 8 ] , with downsampling set to 0.5. It can be noticed that our smallest TGTNet model outperforms PointNet ++ by almost 9% in Real object F1 and 20% in ghost F1. Surprisingly, modifications that increase the model’s complexity appear to reduce its performance. We argue that this happens because of the dataset’s small size, which encourages overfitting.
blocks.zh: 表四显示我们的模型在PointNet ++的修改后的结果。 这个版本保持了与原"PointNet ++"纸上所描述的"语义场景标签"架构完全相同的架构 [8],下标为0.5. 可以注意到,我们最小的TGTNet模型在Real object F1和Ghost F1中以近9%的成绩超过了PointNet ++. 令人惊讶的是,增加模型复杂性的修改似乎降低了其性能. 我们提出,这是因为数据集的体积小,鼓励了过度调整。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 4 ( 4(a) ), S-TGTNet-T accurately classifies all structured clutter detections, unlike the larger models. The smaller 11KB TGTNet variant is also close to the larger models in its classification.

S-TGTNet-T, however, correctly predicts all types of detections and their shapes, but is more conservative with its stationary and clutter prediction, thus estimating a larger moving object footprint than the ground truth and the larger models.

blocks.en: V Conclusions and future work
blocks.zh: 五. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We presented lightweight graph transformer models for clutter and target classification in radar point clouds. Different lightweight variants of the proposed TGTNet model, along with different temporal augmentations, were developed and evaluated. Among these models, applying parallel downsampling and merging the downsampled point clouds was found to be particularly effective, despite its simplicity.
Adding superpoint feature extraction blocks further kept the model size small while achieving precision, recall and F1 classification scores compared to the much larger baseline models.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了轻量级的图变压器模型 在雷达点云中进行整齐和目标分类。 开发并评价了拟议的TGTNet模型的不同轻量级变体,以及不同的时间增强。 在这些模型中,采用平行下取样并合并被下取样的点云被认为特别有效,尽管其简单.
与大得多的基线模型相比,加入超点特征取出区块进一步使模型尺寸小,同时实现精度,召回和F1分类分数.

blocks.en: Finally, based on the performance that temporal augmentations bring, future work could involve utilizing pre-trained point cloud flow estimator networks to estimate the past positions of the points in the current point cloud, yielding more informative neighborhoods. Since the proposed models use 32-bit floating-point parameters, methods such as quantization-aware training could prove useful in further reducing memory footprint and computational cost. Future work will also focus on further optimizing the proposed models for deployment on automotive-grade processors.
blocks.zh: 最后,根据时间增强带来的绩效,今后的工作可能涉及利用事先训练的点云流估计器网络来估计点在目前点云中的过去位置,从而产生更多的信息。 由于所拟议的模型使用32位浮点参数,因此量化-意识训练等方法可以被证明有助于进一步减少内存足迹和计算成本. 今后的工作还将侧重于进一步优化拟议的汽车级处理器部署模式。
